div.p: This is an index of all Moore’s working notebooks, as compiled by the Rosenbach Museum and Library in 2015. A few notebooks were kept by Mary Warner Moore, her mother, although these also typically contain writing by Moore or her mother quotes her. As we transcribe and publish each notebook, it will appear in both “Available Notebook Editions” and the “Index.” Each list can be sorted by notebook number, date, and type. As we publish each notebook, we change the number to Arabic numerals (e.g., 07.03.11) to distinguish it from the Rosenbach’s manuscripts (VII:03:11).
Click on a column head to sort the table of contents according to that feature.
For more information about Moore’s notebooks, see "About the Notebooks."
To download the full index of Moore's notebooks as a CSV file, visit MMDA Box.
